difference: The new Universalraum natural p-to-p^2 torsion inclusion fails Weyl commutators for unital maps. This construction instead uses two-sided p^-k/p^k lattices and nonunital corner embeddings; it explicitly does NOT identify the old torsion transitions. Unit-preserving compression runs in the reverse direction. The compact stabilizer vacuum fixes phases and keeps both U and V, unlike the single commutative End_F4(A). Old v838 corner positivity and PARABOLIC.DETLINE.02 trace-normalization obstructions are not evaded: no full Weil identity is asserted. Classical p-adic Weil theory is acknowledged.
